question: Is the guest-browser FLOW census-miss caused by the selfhost kotoba kernel object route, or by stage history in the profile?

object.route: selfhost (amu selfhost compiler lineage; G1=G2=G3 asserted in prior JUN-31 evidence)

A-selfhost-full-profile.profile: guest-browser full (AIUEOS_GUEST_BROWSER=1, synthetic=0), real virtio-keyboard + virtio-tablet via QMP
A-selfhost-full-profile.stage-order: SCALE(100->125->150->100, SCALE_OK events=16) -> RING -> EDIT -> CLOCK -> SETTINGS(n=4 sets pct=125, written=2, stored=1, frame text-px 668->1757 = 2.63x) -> FLOW

B-synthetic-profile-pct100.CORRECTION (follow-up, 2026-10-24 05:55: the first commit of this receipt called B 'same selfhost object route'. Re-measured: the synthetic run in build/aiueos-syn booted KERNEL.ELF 0f85a7be (image receipt 02:31:10 JST, tree 8820d3b2) and a reloc-masked .text search (.text+3..+5 masked = the link-time relocation) finds the COMMITTED object 3f7409bf 35-byte .text at file offset 325792 and no selfhost-0e04108e .text. B is the committed-object pct=100 pass.
B-synthetic-profile-pct100.profile: synthetic-input (no scale stage, scale stays pct=100)

B2-selfhost-synthetic-profile-pct100.source: docs/evidence/aiueos-kernel-image-selfhost-20261024/kernel-serial.log (committed at 8820d3b2, 2026-10-24 01:53 JST), image KERNEL.ELF 99f908be with the selfhost object .text at file offset 324461 (containment byte-proven at that commit)
B2-selfhost-synthetic-profile-pct100.profile: synthetic-input (no scale stage, scale stays pct=100)
B2-selfhost-synthetic-profile-pct100.serial-log-identity: the full serial log is byte-identical (sha1 feacee9ee27dad36d4042f8a13f808ed8b98b05a) to the committed-object synthetic run's serial log (build/aiueos-syn/kernel-serial.log)

C-op-stream-identity.measured: sha1 of the words hex string re-computed in the follow-up across build/control-run4.log (E), build/control-syn-run.log (B), docs/evidence/aiueos-kernel-image-selfhost-20261024/kernel-serial.log (B2) and docs/evidence/aiueos-image-route-node-free-20261022/boot/kernel-serial.log - all 42fd9ed6
C-op-stream-identity.meaning: the drawn op stream is the same in every run; only the rendered magnification differs

D-object-containment.method: ELF .text extracted from each object; base offset located in KERNEL.ELF; byte compare; reloc-masked search (.text+3..+5 masked)
D-object-containment.re-measured-in-follow-up: A(ab5f25d0) contains only selfhost .text at 325888; E(3e8bdb0e) contains only committed .text at 325888; build/aiueos-syn image (0f85a7be) contains only committed .text at 325792 - this last finding is what corrects B

image.image-receipt: build/aiueos-d/image-receipt.edn, recorded 2026-10-24 05:14:41 JST, tree c76675e, dirty-entries 0

E-control-cell.status: MEASURED in the follow-up commit; run log build/control-run4.log (detached boot 05:13 JST, harness end 05:41 JST)
E-control-cell.stage-order: SETTINGS(n=1..3 pct=100 -> n=4..6 pct=125, written=2, stored=1, frame text-px 668->1757 = 2.63x) -> FLOW
E-control-cell.separate-known-flake: the run then reproduced the #108 process-phase stall (GUEST-NO-EXIT after 523s, attempts=3, quiescence watchdog); not used as evidence

matrix.layout: census (text-px/hash) by object route x active UI scale at FLOW
matrix.note: the pct=100 runs are at tree 8820d3b2 (one commit earlier than the pct=125 runs at c76675e); the op stream is byte-identical across both trees and both objects

attribution: The FLOW census-miss tracks the SETTINGS stage's persisted UI scale, not the object route. All four matrix cells are measured: at fixed profile the two object routes give byte-identical censuses (A=E=9564/b2fad8a7 at pct=125; B=B2=3593/a19f95a8 at pct=100), the op stream (FLOW_OPS words sha1 42fd9ed6) is byte-identical in every run, and each image's linked object is byte-proven.

gate-proposal.option-a: measure the FLOW census at a fixed pct (restore pct=100 before the FLOW stage) and keep the single pin 3593/a19f95a8
gate-proposal.option-b: scale-indexed pins (pct=100: 3593/a19f95a8; pct=125: 9564/b2fad8a7 as measured here)
gate-proposal.recommendation: option-a: one canonical pin keeps the census comparable across profile changes
gate-proposal.root-cause-timeline: pin calibrated ADR-0234 (90f8b03, 2026-09-25) at pct=100; scale stage landed later in ADR-0261 (62490d0, 2026-10-23 16:32, PR #470) - the FLOW pin predates the stage that changes the scale before FLOW

boundary: kernel/*.c is still compiled by zig cc; the C-free claim covers the compiler lineage and the kotoba object route only. The #108 process-phase stall is a separate known flake and is not used as evidence here. B2's image (99f908be) no longer exists in build/ (the dir was rebuilt); its containment rests on the byte-proof recorded at commit 8820d3b2, its census and serial-log identity were re-measured here.
